description: A fixed-form AREA-A ITEM - a division, section or paragraph header, a level indicator (FD, SD, RD), level-number 01 or 77, DECLARATIVES, END DECLARATIVES or an end marker - that does not begin its line in area A (character positions 8-11). ANSI X3.23-1985's reference format split the program-text area at margin B into area A and area B and began each area-A item in area A; ISO/IEC 1989:2002 removed the split, and the 2023 program-text area 'begins in character position 8 and terminates with the character position immediately to the left of margin R' (ISO §2023:6.3.1) with no area. So the placement is free from 2002 on and an area-A item outside area A is refused at COBOL-85 (kb/Work PB3147). Asked of every token by ONE pass, AreaPlacementPass, from the reference format's own record of where each fixed-form line's text begins (ReferenceFormatMap.PlacementAt through FixedFormAreas). The edition edge is DERIVED, not quoted (VCR row 7.35): the repo holds no 1985 or 2002 text; GnuCOBOL 3.2's cobol85.conf sets areacheck: yes and its cobol2002.conf areacheck: no, and the NIST CCVS-85 corpus writes every area-A item in area A (NC113M tests positions 8-11, OBNC1M's comment-entry is a whole program in area B).
display: an area-A item that does not begin its fixed-form line in area A
citation: ANSI X3.23-1985 reference format, area A; ISO §2023:6.3.1: no areas from 2002
vcr: VCR Table 7 row 7.35 - areas A and B of the fixed-form program-text area, removed in 2002
